home.title: A community forest that keeps local history and coastal birch standing strong.
home.intro: Welcome to the French Village Conservation Woodland at 71 St. Pauls Lane—27 acres of protected forest and wetlands. Walk the one-way trail to eight simple stops, from the exercise bar to the labyrinth, discover community stories along the way, and return the same route as the forest soundtrack changes around you.

explore.title: Explore the Conservation Area
explore.body: Follow the signed one kilometre trail out to wells, resting clearings, and the woodland labyrinth, then wander back through shifting light.

photos.title: Share & Explore Photos
photos.body: Browse community photos and add your own snapshots to show how the woods change through the year.

education.title: Conservation Education
education.body: Meet the plants and wildlife that call this forest home and learn how we protect their habitat.

trail.label: Gentle out-and-back trail with eight simple landmarks and easy grades.

stops.label: Exercise bar, wells, resting clearings, listening telephone, and the labyrinth.

birch.label: Yellow birch stands and mixed forest cared for through invasive removal.

volunteers.label: Neighbours and partners look after the path, signage, and stewardship events.
